name: Metal Barns
description:
Metal Barns vs. Wood: What Actually Holds Up?

Ask any farmer who has replaced rotted siding twice in a decade and the appeal of steel becomes obvious. Metal won’t warp, rot, or feed a termite colony, so the hours and dollars normally lost to patching and repainting stay in your pocket. A steel barn shrugs off driving rain, heavy snow loads, and relentless sun, which means the equipment, feed, and animals inside stay protected through every season. Decade after decade, with little more than the occasional wash-down, a metal barn keeps doing its job long after a wooden structure would have needed replacing.

Custom Farm and Ranch Buildings

Your farm, your barn. No two operations run the same way, so every structure we build is shaped around the way you actually work. Store hay, shelter livestock, park machinery, host a fall gathering, or simply keep the truck out of the hail — the layout is yours to decide. You choose the footprint, the interior arrangement, the roof style, the color palette, the doors, the windows, the trim, the wainscoting, and everything in between. Adjust any detail until the building matches what you pictured. At this level of customization, there is very little we can’t accommodate.

Metal Barn Kits Durability Saves Time and Money

Agricultural buildings take a beating — daily traffic, heavy loads, and whatever the weather decides to do that week. Top Goat Metal Structures steel barns are engineered for exactly that punishment, outlasting comparable wooden buildings by a wide margin. We use high-grade American steel and properly engineered foundations so the structure resists weather and wear from the frame outward. For a working producer, that translates into fewer repair weekends, lower lifetime cost, and an asset that holds its value on the property.

Metal Barn Kit Styles

Choosing a barn starts with matching the style to the job. Our Horse Barns are laid out around equine care, our Carolina Barns carry the signature curved sides, and our Seneca Barns keep everything tidy under one continuous roofline. Each one is built for agricultural work first, though they finish handsomely enough to improve the look of the property. Dimensions, colors, and components are all adjustable — tack rooms, storage lofts, and more. We also design around the details that make a barn usable day to day: a climate-controlled office tucked into the corner, purpose-built stables and stalls, oversized doors sized to your equipment, and a workshop bay so machinery repairs happen on-site instead of across the county. Not sure which layout fits your operation? Our barn specialists will walk you through the options.

Horse Barns

A well-planned horse barn protects the investment a rider has made in their animals, even on a farm that handles a dozen other jobs. Our consultants size the building, select the features, and advise on placement based on how your equestrian operation runs — a two-stall hobby setup and a full boarding facility call for very different plans. Every barn we build pairs steel durability with the details horses require, including hay storage, a proper tack room, and kick walls.

Carolina Barns

The Carolina Barn centers an A-frame aisle between facing stalls, a layout equestrian operations tend to favor. It’s an understated design that still reads as stately, and the sheltered common area gives owners, handlers, and horses room to move without crowding. Overhead clearance in the raised center aisle is generous enough for a mounted rider and comfortable for grooming. Built from long-lasting steel, these barns take heavy daily traffic and keep the weather out season after season.

Seneca Barns

Seneca Barns pair A-frame roofing — vertical or boxed-eave, depending on your preference — with a single continuous roofline across the structure. The result is a clean, uncluttered profile backed by serious structural strength. Our team can recommend the framing, roof orientation, and height that make the most sense for your climate and your workload.

All Steel Barns from Top Goat Metal Structures Represent Quality and Trust

Buying from Top Goat means buying more than a steel shell. It means craftsmanship, materials that hold up, and a service team that stays with you after the crew drives away. Every Top Goat building includes:
  • 1-Year Workmanship Warranty
We’re proud of the work our crews do, and we back it. Your barn goes up quickly and correctly — and if something isn’t right, we return and fix it. The one-year workmanship warranty covers anything tied to the installation itself.
  • 10-Year Panel Warranty Against Chipping and Cracking
Panels are covered for a full decade against chipping and cracking, so the finish stays intact no matter what the weather throws at it.
  • 20-Year Rust-Through Warranty
Twenty years of rust-through coverage means the structure stays as tough as the work you put into it.
  • 14 Custom Color Options
A barn should suit the property it sits on. With fourteen colors to choose from, finding a shade that works with your house, fencing, and outbuildings is easy — and the finish will still look sharp years down the road.
  • Extensive Customization Options
Layout, finishes, and everything between are yours to specify. Pick custom dimensions, color combinations, wainscoting, trim, and ventilation to end up with a barn nobody else has.
  • Flexible Financing Options
We partner with trusted lenders to keep financing simple and rewarding. Terms run from 24 to 72 months, with loans up to $50,000 on approved credit.
  • Rent-to-Own Options
Prefer to skip traditional financing? Select structures qualify for rent-to-own. Approvals are quick, there’s no hard credit check, and paying off early costs you nothing extra. Pay at your own pace and use your building from day one. Whether you need room for oversized tractors and implements or a comfortable place to house horses and livestock, Top Goat Metal Structures is a name you can count on. Our steel structures and metal barn kits use premium materials, get customized to your taste, and are engineered to do the job right the first time.

name: Metal Buildings
description:
Customize Your Metal Building Your Way

No two projects start from the same place, and your building shouldn’t be a copy of someone else’s. That’s why nearly every element is yours to specify: overall dimensions, roofing style, the placement of windows and doors, colors, trim, wainscoting, and more. Want to go further? Insulation improves climate control, frame-outs leave room for changes down the line, and details like cupolas or skylights give the structure real character. Whatever you have in mind, the Top Goat Metal Structures team will help you get there.

Building Size Range Options

Our metal buildings and steel building kits come in a wide span of sizes. Here’s a quick guide to help you narrow it down:
  1. 12’ to 18’ Metal Buildings : Best suited to small residential projects — enough room for tools, lawn equipment, or a tucked-away workspace without taking over the yard.
  2. 18’ to 24’ Metal Buildings : A natural fit for garages, storage units, and compact barns. Medium-sized residential and agricultural jobs land here, gaining usable space without an oversized footprint.
  3. 24’ to 32’ Steel Buildings : Common for bigger residential and farm needs such as vehicle storage, full-size barns, and modest workshops.
  4. 32’ to 42’ Metal Buildings : Sized for commercial work and small warehouses, with enough room for inventory and day-to-day operations.
  5. 42’ to 52’ Steel Buildings : Built for large-scale storage and commercial use, handling substantial equipment or high-volume inventory.
  6. 52’ to 70’ and Beyond (Custom) : For expansive commercial, agricultural, and industrial facilities. Custom sizing means square footage stops being the limiting factor.

DIY Cold-Formed Steel Building Kits

Our cold-formed steel building kits make it straightforward to put up a customizable metal structure without a full construction crew, and they scale across the size ranges above. Reach out today and we’ll help you spec a hassle-free steel building kit for your property.

name: Metal Carports
description:
Our Metal Carports Feature

A Top Goat carport isn’t just a roof on posts — it’s a storage solution meant to stay standing for the long haul. Every carport we sell comes with:
  1. Concrete or Rebar Anchors for StabilityOur anchoring systems tie the carport firmly to its base. Soil, asphalt, or concrete — whichever foundation you have, we match the anchors to it.
  2. A 1-Year Craftsmanship WarrantyWe back the quality of our installations. The one-year craftsmanship warranty is our promise that your steel building goes up fast, cleanly, and above all correctly.
  3. A 10 to 20-Year Warranty on Framing and PanelingThese carports are made to last, and the framing and paneling warranties reflect that with years of coverage behind them.
  4. Choice Between 14 Color OptionsMatch your home, match your barn, or mix two shades for a scheme that stands out. Fourteen colors give you plenty of room to play.
  5. Virtual 3D Modeling Program for Easy CustomizationSee the changes before you commit. Our 3D Builder lets you view and adjust your structure in real time from a laptop or your phone.
  6. Custom Features and AccessoriesGable ends, side panels, doors, windows — add what you need to make the carport work harder.
  7. Financing and Rent-to-Own PackagesFlexible financing and rent-to-own plans put the right carport within reach without straining the budget.
  8. Included Delivery and InstallationNo chasing down third-party contractors. Book your install date, prep the site, and our crew handles the rest.

Residential Metal Carports vs. Commercial Carports

The gap between a residential and a commercial carport is narrower than most people expect. The silhouette is largely the same and the materials come from the same stock. Where they diverge is in configuration, paneling, and framing. Take framing thickness: 14-gauge steel is the residential standard, while commercial carports — particularly those facing constant heavy use — step up to 12-gauge for extra rigidity. Paneling follows the same logic. Residential builds typically use 29-gauge steel, whereas commercial sites and locations with punishing weather are better served by heavier 26-gauge panels.

Top Goat Metal Structures Premium Carports

Every Top Goat Metal Structures carport is built from top-tier galvanized steel and sheet metal. Here’s a look at the single-car, two-car, and partially enclosed configurations we offer:

Convenient Single Car Carports

Our single-car covers start at 12′ x 21′ with roughly six feet of side clearance — enough to open a door and walk around the vehicle comfortably. Heavy-gauge steel components shelter cars, recreational gear, and whatever else needs to stay dry. Simple to use, and dependable enough that you stop thinking about it.

Spacious Two-Car Carports

Ranging from 18 to 24 feet wide, these covers comfortably shelter two full-size vehicles — or a tractor, an RV, or a boat on a trailer when that’s the priority.

Partially Enclosed Carports

Add galvanized steel gable ends, side panels, or a garage-door wall to block more sun and wind. Enclose one side, three sides, or all of it, depending on how much shelter you actually need.

Utility Carports

Utility carports combine open shelter with a lockable enclosed section, adjustable in 5-foot increments so you only pay for the space you’ll use. Any standard carport can be converted this way, turning it into a flexible utility building that parks vehicles on one end and secures tools and valuables on the other.

Carport Functionality: Storage, Shade & Shelter

Parking is only where a carport starts. These are genuinely mixed-use spaces, and they adapt as your needs shift — which is a large part of why owners end up using them for far more than they planned. Keep cars, boats, and trailers under galvanized steel and out of the sun, storms, and freeze-thaw cycles that quietly wear vehicles down. Covered storage is one of the cheapest ways to protect an expensive asset. Set one up as a patio or pavilion and the backyard changes. Customizable shade options turn an exposed slab into a spot where people actually want to gather. And the shelter works year-round — heavy snow, steady rain, blistering afternoons, or a hard freeze. People, animals, and belongings all get the same reliable break from the weather.

name: Metal Garages
description:
Metal Garages at Top Goat Metal Structures

Order from Top Goat and you get more than sheets of steel on a frame — you get a storage solution built around how you’ll use it. Here’s what comes with it:
  1. Instant Metal Garage Pricing No hidden fees, no surprise line items. Our pricing calculator shows how each size and upgrade moves the number, so you can find the build that fits your budget before you ever talk to us.
  2. Fast Delivery and Installation Quick delivery and professional installation get your garage in service sooner. We keep the process moving from the day you order through the day the crew finishes — typically 4–8 weeks to installation.
  3. Certified Metal Buildings Our certified garages are engineered to meet or exceed local standards for wind load, snow accumulation, and seismic activity. Mild climate or extreme one, the structure is rated for where it stands.
  4. Superior Customer Service We stay involved from the first phone call through installation day and well past it. Our team is here to make the process smooth and to answer whatever comes up along the way.

Customize Your Very Own Metal Garage

Your needs are specific and your garage should be too. Top Goat Metal Structures offers a deep set of options: pick your dimensions, roof style, door types, and colors, then layer on windows, insulation, or extra features that make the space more useful. It takes only a few steps. Use our online 3-D Designer Tool to configure your steel building, then send the specs to our team for a FREE quote. Designing the structure you need has never been this straightforward.

Metal Garages for Storing Multiple Vehicles

Top Goat Metal Structures builds prefab metal garages for one, two, three, or more vehicles, in whatever style suits the property. They add secure storage to a home or business and keep vehicles and assets out of the weather. We work through the details with you so the finished garage matches your specifications rather than a catalog default. A compact one-car build handles a single vehicle with room to move around it; families needing more parking usually step up to a two- or three-bay layout. Plenty of single-car owners size up anyway, using the extra bay as a workshop or overflow storage. Whatever the mix, we tailor the building to your parking count and everything else you plan to do inside it.

One-Car Garage

A one-car steel garage from Top Goat makes better use of the land you already own and adds value in the process. Enclosed single-vehicle units suit cars, trucks, boats, RVs, and equipment equally well. They’re a smart addition when you need protected, durable storage on-site without committing to a large footprint.

Spacious Two-Car Garage

Our prefab two-car garages generally run 20 to 24 feet wide, which is ample covered parking for two vehicles. If your situation calls for something different, we’ll build to whatever dimensions make double-vehicle storage work on your property.

Side Entry Garage

Top Goat Metal Structures also builds prefab steel garages with a side entry door, so you’re not raising a full vehicle door every time you need to grab something. A side entry means quick access without dumping your heated or cooled air outside. It’s a practical upgrade that also sharpens the look of the building — easier entry and exit, better protection for what’s inside, and improved energy efficiency every time you use it.

description: Top Goat commercial metal buildings are built for the demands of real industry — warehousing, manufacturing, retail, automotive work, and heavy industrial operations alike. Clear-span framing leaves the interior wide open, with no columns interrupting storage racks, production lines, or equipment movement. These are heavy-duty structures meant for demanding daily use, and they can be configured to fit both how your business runs and how your brand looks. Choose the size, colors, roofing, insulation, doors, windows, and any structural reinforcements the site calls for. Warehouse, shop floor, or production facility — the result is a building that flexes with the business and keeps performing for years.
second_description:
Our Commercial Buildings Tackle Everything

Whatever line of work you’re in, there’s a Top Goat commercial building suited to it. They adapt to almost any field, and they’re tough enough for the heavy-duty end of the spectrum. A sample of the industries putting them to work:
  • Warehousing
Uninterrupted square footage makes these ideal for goods storage — room to stack high, room to move a forklift, and no columns dictating your layout.
  • Manufacturing
Manufacturers face the same space problem. Our buildings accommodate large machinery, work vehicles, and the clearance a production floor demands.
  • Retail
From a small boutique to a big-box footprint, steel is an attractive and adaptable option for retail. There’s room for inventory, room to merchandise, and the ability to finish the space however your concept requires.
  • Automotive
Automotive businesses do well in steel. Repair bays, a detailing studio, a sales floor — the open interior handles all of it.
  • Industrial
Larger industrial operations benefit too. Processing plants, textile facilities, and similar sites make full use of the open clear-span footprint.

Customize Your Commercial Metal Building

Roofing panels down to the wainscoting — every component can be specified to suit the operation. Build around your workflow while keeping the exterior on-brand. You control the footprint, roofing style, color scheme, door and window counts, insulation, lean-tos, framing and panel reinforcements, and a good deal more. A high-bay warehouse, a manufacturing center, a brewery, a restaurant: we’ll build the structure the business actually needs.

Commercial Building Kits

Our commercial building kits let you handle installation without hiring a crew, which makes them a sensible option for capable DIY teams. Each kit ships with clear guidelines so you can put up a fully functional commercial structure on your own schedule.

Commercial Building Prices

Top Goat Metal Structures sells prefabricated commercial buildings at factory-direct pricing. Final cost depends on the specifics — wind and snow load requirements, specialty upgrades, and similar factors — while delivery and installation timelines shift with your location and the weather. Even with those variables, we hold pricing competitive so a workable building stays within reach at most budgets. Widths run from 32 ft. to 60 ft., all priced fairly. Financing and rent-to-own programs are available, and our direct relationships with leading manufacturers help us keep pricing honest, delivery quick, and quality high.

What You Get When You Buy a Top Goat Building

These aren’t ordinary metal sheds. They’re working answers to business problems, large and small. Order from us and here’s what comes with it:
  1. Certified Commercial Metal BuildingsOur commercial structures are certified for the wind gusts, snowfall, and seismic activity typical of your region — so whatever the business, the building is rated for the environment it sits in.
  2. Free Delivery and InstallationBoth are included with every purchase. You prep the site and secure the permits; we take care of everything else.
  3. Accurate PricingDesigning is easy with our 3D Designer tool, and pricing is just as simple. No hidden fees or last-minute changes — configure the structure, get a FREE quote, put down a deposit.
  4. Customer Service that Goes BeyondFrom the first call through installation day, we work alongside you to keep the process painless. Industry-leading warranties back every structure, and our specialists are on hand for any question.

name: Utility Buildings
description:
What is an RV Garage?

An RV garage is exactly what the name suggests — a metal building sized for recreational vehicles, motorhomes, and campers. The difference is scale: taller walls, wider bays, and more interior room than a standard garage can offer, because a Class A coach doesn’t fit in a space built for a sedan. Size is only part of it. These buildings are engineered to keep harsh weather, UV exposure, and everything else that degrades a rig from reaching it. Between customizable entry points and reinforced framing, an RV garage is a solid answer for anyone who wants their vehicle protected during the months it isn’t on the road.

Customization Options for RV Garages

RV garages from Top Goat Metal Structures reflect the people who own them. Our options let you land on a structure that fits both the rig and the property. Here’s what you can adjust:
  • Size and Dimensions: Set the height, width, and length around your RV — plus whatever else you plan to keep in there.
  • Doors and Entryways: Roll-up doors, walk-in doors, or side entries make getting in and out simple.
  • Roof Styles: Regular, boxed-eave, or vertical roofing, chosen for your taste and your local weather.
  • Colors and Finishes: Walls, roof, and trim can be finished in a range of colors to complement the house and the rest of the property.
  • Insulation: Insulation packages steady the interior temperature and shield your RV from extreme heat and cold.

The Many Uses for RV Garages

Very few of these buildings end up storing only an RV. Owners regularly use them for:
  • Vehicle Protection: Boats, trailers, and trucks can share the space, staying sheltered and secure alongside the RV.
  • Maintenance and Repairs: An indoor bay makes routine service and DIY repair work far easier, whatever you’re working on.
  • Storage Space: Camping gear, tools, and other bulky items stay out of the weather and out of the yard.
  • Workshop or Hobby Space: Partition off a section for woodworking, crafting, or whatever project keeps you busy between trips.

Top Goat Metal Structures is Your Premier Source for RV Garages

Give your RV a garage kits that does more than you expected it to. Top Goat Metal Structures brings industry-leading craftsmanship, durable materials, and a deep list of options so the finished building goes the distance right along with the vehicle inside it. Paying for it should be straightforward too. We work with nationally recognized lenders to offer flexible financing across our buildings, with fast approvals and no penalty for paying off early — so you can settle on terms that fit your situation. Give your vehicle the armor it deserves. Call Top Goat Metal Structures at [site_phone] to start designing your RV metal garage. We’ll guide you through every step and show you exactly why these buildings carry the Top Goat name.
